spread_description: The flow of a situation across time: past, present and future.

cards.position_meaning: Roots and events already shaping the situation.
cards.name: Ten of Wands
cards.meaning: A figure strains beneath ten heavy wands toward a distant home, carrying more than necessary.

cards.position_meaning: The current dynamics and where you stand now.
cards.name: Knight of Swords
cards.meaning: Reversed, fearless drive becomes reckless aggression and scattered, blunt force.

cards.position_meaning: The likely direction if things continue as they are.
cards.name: Queen of Wands
cards.meaning: Reversed, confidence wavers into jealousy or self-doubt; reclaim your self-respect.

synthesis: Reading the Three Card (时间之流三张). Past (过去) draws Ten of Wands (权杖十) upright, highlighting burden, extra responsibility, hard work. Present (现在) draws Knight of Swords (宝剑骑士) reversed, highlighting aggression, impulsiveness, haste. Future (未来) draws Queen of Wands (权杖王后) reversed, highlighting self-respect, introverted, re-establish. No Major Arcana appeared, so the reading turns on everyday, practical forces you can act on directly rather than on larger destiny-level themes. 2 reversed card(s) point to energies that are blocked, internalised or delayed, and ask to be examined rather than forced.
